summary: Independently adjudicated the predecessor repair phase's (commits a0225cf8/08bfdc12/8bfce890/cc4e8364/fbcaa519) claim that TelegramSink now persists durable, purpose-built per-operation Telegram acceptance receipts (PREPARED -> API_ACCEPTED/API_REJECTED/TRANSPORT_FAILED/OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN), fixing the historical defect where real Telegram Bot API responses were consumed in-process and then discarded, leaving no durable post-hoc proof of API acceptance. From primary source (not the predecessor's own tests/report): independently reproduced the original defect from pre-repair code; independently reconstructed the bounded production diff (notifications.py/phase_reports.py/tests/conftest.py only, no contract/schema/dependency change); independently reconstructed the full notification call graph; confirmed the purpose-built receipt does not bypass an already-active canonical mechanism (the Delivery Receipt/Pipeline architecture remains dormant/synthetic); confirmed compute_report_digest excludes notification_result with no digest circularity; precisely characterized durability as atomic tmp-write + os.replace (process-exit/restart durable, no fsync, not overclaimed by the repair). Authored and ran a fresh, independent 23-test adversarial suite (tests/test_iv_telegram_receipt_fresh.py) covering pre-attempt ordering proven via disk reload, strict API_ACCEPTED/API_REJECTED/TRANSPORT_FAILED/OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN classification, partial summary/document outcomes, receipt-persistence failure after API acceptance (never framed as safely resendable), secret exclusion (bot token/API URL/chat_id absent from receipts and the PERSISTENCE-FAILURES.log fallback, verified by byte grep), dedup/receipt separation, legacy report compatibility, no automatic retry, and receipt non-authority -- 23/23 passed. Predecessor's own 41-test suite re-run unchanged as regression evidence only: 41/41 passed. One disclosed non-blocking finding (F-1): report.notification_result["success"] and .last-notified.json dedup still derive from raw Telegram ok booleans, not gated on the new strict classification -- this matches the repair's own disclosed scope ("never replaces or redefines success"), so it does not contradict the repair's claims; recorded as a candidate for a future narrow follow-up, not repaired here. No production code was modified, no defect found during this IV was repaired, no historical re-dispatch was performed, and no historical receipt was fabricated. VERDICT: DURABLE TELEGRAM ACCEPTANCE RECEIPT / PHASE-NOTIFICATION AUDITABILITY REPAIR: INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED. The separate post-completion full-repository sweep (40587 passed / 979 failed / 117 errors) remains frozen, separate evidence, neither classified nor repaired here. F-5 continuation execution remains HOLD pending that separate triage. N-16-5 remains NOT CLOSED.
derived_correctness: Independently exercised via a fresh deterministic fake-HTTP seam (no real network calls, no live bot token): PREPARED receipt for both summary and document confirmed persisted-to-disk (reload-verified, not in-memory) strictly before the corresponding network call; ok:true with a valid integer message_id classifies API_ACCEPTED and the exact message_id survives a fresh disk reload after send() returns; ok:true with missing/malformed result or message_id (including a bare bool, a documented low-severity non-blocking finding since isinstance(True, int) is True in Python but never observed from real Telegram responses) classifies OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN, never API_ACCEPTED; a real API rejection and a raised transport exception classify to distinct statuses, neither ever described as sent/accepted/delivered; invalid JSON never yields API_ACCEPTED; summary-accepted/document-rejected, summary-accepted/document-transport-failed, and summary-accepted/document-uncertain are each represented as two independent, non-colliding receipts with the aggregate result never falsely claiming complete two-operation success; a hard exception after PREPARED leaves an auditable non-accepted state; a forced final-receipt write failure after a validated API-accepted response does not crash the sink, is exposed as a persistence-failure signal, and is never treated as safely resendable; the PERSISTENCE-FAILURES.log fallback and every receipt JSON file were grepped byte-for-byte for the test's own bot token, the raw api.telegram.org/bot<token> URL, and the raw chat_id -- all absent in every case, with a stable, non-reversible destination alias used instead that changes when the destination changes; .last-notified.json's schema and read/write sites confirmed to carry no message_id/acceptance field and never be conflated with receipt evidence; a legacy phase report lacking telegram_receipts loads without crashing and without a fabricated message_id/status; no automatic retry exists for uncertain or persistence-failure outcomes; a second dispatch allocates a new receipt_id rather than overwriting the first attempt's evidence; a terminology grep confirms none of human_delivered/delivered_to_human/human_received/read/seen describe API acceptance anywhere in the changed files.
